title: Input-trajectory integration and irregular-time HDC-LTC bake-off

canonical_source.incumbent: evolve_closed_form uses one supplied input vector for the whole dt
canonical_source.rk4: evolve_rk4 calls compute_derivative with the same input at all four stages
canonical_source.iterative: evolve_closed_form_iterative recomputes equilibrium/tau, but still uses constant input at all substeps
canonical_source.fourier_reference_caveat: compute_equilibrium includes optional Fourier basis; compute_derivative currently does not. The current RK4 path is not a same-equation reference for Fourier-enabled runs until this is resolved.

methods.name: raw_feature_interpolate_then_encode
methods.input_path: interpolate raw feature endpoints then encode each stage

methods.name: causal_lagrange_degree_2
methods.input_path: causal polynomial through current and historical input endpoints

methods.name: causal_lagrange_degree_3
methods.input_path: causal cubic interpolation from current and historical points

methods.name: adaptive_curvature_or_innovation
methods.input_path: adaptive quadrature/substeps with deterministic evaluation budget

methods.name: event_discontinuity_aware_hold
methods.input_path: declared hold/reset behavior; no interpolation across discontinuity

input_path_equations.causality: u[n] is used only after it arrives; no sample after t[n] may affect the interval
input_path_equations.raw_vs_hv: raw feature interpolation and ContinuousHV interpolation are distinct candidates
input_path_equations.normalization: do not normalize interpolated HVs unless separately versioned and tested

underlying_ode.reference: variable-input RK4 with u evaluated at each RK stage; refine until successive trajectories meet predeclared tolerance
underlying_ode.stage_inputs: k1 at alpha=0; k2 and k3 at alpha=0.5; k4 at alpha=1
underlying_ode.note: ODE reference is not assumed to be identical to the learned-gating closed-form update.

learned_gating.candidates: evaluate the same gate/equilibrium rule at each input-path substep; do not alter sigma_base law
learned_gating.statistics: separate internal substeps from external observation intervals; update running statistics according to an explicit fixed policy

numerical_contracts.fourier_gate: compute_equilibrium includes optional Fourier basis computed from self.total_time; compute_derivative does not. Since update_stats(dt) advances total_time after the RK4 call, true time-varying Fourier forcing requires basis evaluation at each RK stage time t0, t0+dt/2, t0+dt/2, t0+dt. Otherwise label it interval-held Fourier snapshot. See issue #9373.

time_and_event_contract.budget_exhaustion: explicit incomplete/fallback status; no partial-success status

task_conditions.expected_control: linear input path is the matched path
do not smooth across marked event

workload_families: Symthaea temporal associative recall (pinned oracle required)
Symthaea streaming sequence classification (pinned oracle required)
DFA-CfN original task families only after original split/preprocessing and code audit
non_claims: Input interpolation has not been shown to improve Symthaea HDC-LTC.
The existing RK4 implementation is not a same-equation oracle for Fourier-enabled runs until the source mismatch is resolved.
A linear or polynomial input path is not assumed valid for discontinuous event streams.
No NIALIM result or SOTA claim has been reproduced.
No production default or hardware performance claim is authorized.
